CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub Data_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
If Nz(Data, "") = "" Then Exit Sub

If Month(Data) <> DLookup("Luna", "LunaD", "IDL= " & Forms!prezenta!IDL) Then
    MsgBox "Atentie! Documentul de retur TREBUIE sa fie din luna selectata!!!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    Cancel = True
End If

End Sub

Private Sub Form_BeforeInsert(Cancel As Integer)
If Nz(Forms!prezenta!IDP, "") = "" Then
    MsgBox "Alege copilul caruia vrei sa ii restitui suma!", vbOKOnly + vbCritical
    Cancel = True
    Exit Sub
End If

If Nz(DSum("ValoareTotala", "Prezenta", "IDP=" & Forms!prezenta!IDP), 0) + Nz(DSum("SI", "Prezenta", "IDP=" & Forms!prezenta!IDP), 0) = 0 Then
    If Abs(Nz(DLookup("SI", "Platitori", "IDP=" & Forms!prezenta!IDP), 0)) >= 0 Then
        MsgBox "Copilul selectat nu are niciun fel de sold creditor!", vbOKOnly + vbCritical
        Cancel = True
    End If
Else
    If Nz(DSum("ValoareTotala", "Prezenta", "IDP=" & Forms!prezenta!IDP), 0) + Nz(DSum("SI", "Prezenta", "IDP=" & Forms!prezenta!IDP), 0) >= Nz(DSum("Plata", "Plati", "IDP=" & Forms!prezenta!IDP), 0) Then
        MsgBox "Nu exista sold creditor pentru " & Forms!prezenta!Prezenta_sub!IDP_p & "!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
End If

IDR = Nz(DMax("idr", "Retur"), 0) + 1
CL = IDR
IDZ = Forms!prezenta!IDZ
IDP = Forms!prezenta!IDP
IDS = DLookup("IDS", "Platitori_sub", "Activ=True AND IDP=" & IDP)
IDL = Forms!prezenta!IDL
Suma = Abs(Nz(DSum("ValoareTotala", "Prezenta", "IDP=" & Forms!prezenta!IDP), 0) + Nz(DSum("SI", "Prezenta", "IDP=" & Forms!prezenta!IDP), 0) - Nz(DSum("Plata", "Plati", "IDP=" & Forms!prezenta!IDP), 0))

If Suma = 0 Then 'daca nu are prezenta, poate are sold initial creditor
    Suma = Abs(Nz(DLookup("SI", "Platitori", "IDP=" & Forms!prezenta!IDP), 0))
End If

End Sub
Private Sub Form_Current()

CL = Me.IDR
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Load()
sav.SetFocus
End Sub

Private Sub KKK_Enter()
sav.SetFocus
End Sub

Private Sub Sav_Click()
If Anulat Then
    MsgBox "Returul selectat este anulat deja!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    Exit Sub
End If

If MsgBox("Doresti anularea returului selectat?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbNo Then Exit Sub

Me.Anulat = True
Me.Requery
End Sub
